name: codex-split-proxy
description: Run a local mihomo split proxy for Codex terminal commands.

interface.shortDescription: Run Codex terminal commands through a split proxy.
interface.longDescription: Starts and manages a local mihomo instance for Codex-launched terminal commands. Mainland China and local network traffic goes direct, while other traffic goes through your Clash-compatible subscription.
defaultPrompt: Run a command through the proxy.
